RANK-DEFICIENCY REPAIR (open #1, implemented as the coordinator specified):
- detect nrep=3 near-null directions of G^T G (block power iteration on cI - Gram), identify the redundant column (argmax|w|), recover the missing eigenvector from the candidate pool as the max-residual candidate against the kept orthonormal basis, Gram-Schmidt it + Rayleigh eigenvalue, replace the redundant column.
- MEASURED: Q_smin moved 0.002 -> up to 0.05 (PARTIAL improvement) but orth stayed 2.6-3.2, eigr 0.08, nbad=8/8 -- did NOT flip.
- ROOT: the band-edge deficiency is RANK-FEW, not rank-1 -- on a gapless dense spectrum EACH interior shift produces a fuzzy edge with a doubled/dropped pair (nways-1 shifts -> ~2+ deficient dirs), so repairing 3 leaves others; and the max-residual pool candidate is NOT a clean eigenvector (its energy is spread over several low-membership candidates), so the recovered column raised eigr. A repair that yields clean eigenvectors for every edge pair == a LOCAL Rayleigh-Ritz, whose cost when m~n (m=2048, n=2048) approaches a full eigh -> no win.

GAP-SEEKING SHIFTS (open #3): WORSE (eigr 0.05-0.11, counts unbalanced). A gapless semicircle spectrum has NO meaningful gaps; the widest gap near a quantile is noise and moving the boundary off the even quantile just unbalances the bands. Gap-seeking needs a spectrum WITH gaps; shape-5 dense-cond1 has none.

COST CEILING (settles the multiway approach for shape-5, independent of the rank fix):
- Even a passing 3-way: cluster work 24 blocks x K=806 ~= depth-1's 16 x K=1072 (measured cluster cost ~ blocks x K), PLUS a 2nd full-n 2048^3 sign function (depth-1 has 1) + subspace-iter + selection + repair GEMMs -> necessarily > depth-1's 89096us.
- Reaching the mega-med n<=512 leaves (the brief's target regime) needs nways>=6 -> 5 full-n 2048^3 sign functions. The multiway sign-func cost scales with nways-1 at the FULL n; the cluster savings (K shrinks only as m/nways) do not keep pace. Unfavorable at n=2048.

Multiway is now blocked ONLY by the band-edge orthogonality/rank-few deficiency, and even if that were cracked the cost ceiling caps it at ~depth-1. Depth-1 binary works because its single-sign-projector halves have NO middle piece and NO band edges (orth 0.65, 0 fallback).
